## What question can't you answer today

flowtrace's commands each answer a specific question (see the table in README.md). Describe
the question you have that no existing command, or no existing flag on an existing command,
answers.

## Proposed shape

If you have one in mind: a new command, a new flag, a new extractor idiom, a new framework
kind. Point at the constraints in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) this would need to
respect (zero runtime dependencies, the single-file build subset, the honesty rule that a
number is never reported without a fact behind it).

## Alternatives considered

What you tried with the existing commands, and why it fell short.

## Would you be able to work on this

Yes / no / with guidance — helps set expectations on turnaround.
